For a 50-person Indian company, I’d shortlist these three current options. Public pricing is limited, so treat the totals below as expected commercial cost, not quoted prices.

Offer	Expected total cost	What to verify before paying
MakeMyTrip myBiz	Booking cost + negotiated service fee; 1.5% extra if using its payment gateway	Service fee per booking, cancellation/reissue fees, credit terms, GST invoices, 24/7 escalation. 
MakeMyTrip
+1

EaseMyTrip EMTDesk	Custom quote; typically booking cost + negotiated fees	Dedicated account manager, after-hours support, amendment/cancellation charges, credit limit, employee-policy controls. 
EaseMyTrip

Thomas Cook India Corporate Travel	Custom quote; usually management/service fees + travel spend	Dedicated servicing team, SLA for emergencies, offline booking charges, credit terms, reporting/reconciliation, international support. 
thomascook.in

Purchase checklist: get a written all-in fee sheet, 30/60-day payment terms, cancellation/reissue tariff, SLA, GST treatment, and confirmation that all 50 employees can book under company policy.

For a 50-person company, I’d request identical 12-month quotes from all three before choosing, because actual travel volume will dominate the headline service fee.
